article.title: Why AI Systems Need an Abstain Option
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

paragraphs.en:
Many AI systems are designed as if every input requires an answer. A user asks a question, the model predicts a label, or a workflow requests an action, and the system is expected to respond. In low-risk settings this can be convenient. In higher-risk settings, however, forcing an answer can be dangerous. Sometimes the best output is to abstain: to say that confidence is insufficient and request more information or human review.

Consider a document-classification system used to route customer complaints. Most cases may be clear, but some documents contain unusual language or belong to several categories. If the model must choose exactly one label, it can produce a confident-looking mistake. An abstain option allows the system to separate routine cases from ambiguous ones and send the latter to a person.

Abstention is especially useful when the cost of a false answer is much higher than the cost of waiting. A recommendation about a movie and a decision affecting a payment do not have the same risk. For a payment workflow, a small delay for verification may be preferable to an incorrect transfer. The acceptable threshold should therefore depend on the consequence of the action, not only on average model accuracy.

A useful abstain policy needs more than a confidence score. Model confidence can itself be poorly calibrated, particularly when inputs differ from training data. Systems can combine several signals: low confidence, disagreement between models, missing required fields, unusual input patterns, failed retrieval, or policy-sensitive content. The goal is to recognize conditions under which automatic processing is less trustworthy.

The human fallback also needs design. Sending every difficult case to a generic queue can create a new bottleneck. The review interface should show why the system abstained, what evidence it found, and what decision is required. Teams should measure review volume, turnaround time, and the rate at which humans confirm or overturn automated suggestions.

There is a trade-off between coverage and risk. If the abstain threshold is too strict, automation handles very few cases and operating costs remain high. If it is too loose, risky mistakes pass through. Managers should choose the threshold using business costs and risk tolerance rather than optimizing a technical metric in isolation. Different actions may require different thresholds.

Abstention can also improve evaluation. Instead of asking only how often the model is correct, teams can measure accuracy on cases the system chooses to handle, coverage of total cases, and error rates among high-risk actions. A system with slightly lower coverage but much safer handled cases may be more valuable than one that answers everything.

Finally, an abstain option changes the product philosophy. It treats uncertainty as information rather than as failure. Reliable systems do not need to pretend that every situation is equally familiar. They need a controlled way to recognize uncertainty, stop before an unsafe action, and transfer the case to a better decision-maker. In many real workflows, knowing when not to answer is part of being useful.
paragraphs.zh: AI 系統若被迫對每個輸入都給答案，在高風險場景可能產生危險。Abstain option 讓系統在信心不足、資料缺失、retrieval 失敗或輸入異常時停止自動處理並交給人。是否 abstain 不應只依賴單一 confidence score，因為模型可能校準不佳；可以綜合多個 signal。Human fallback 也需要設計，包含原因、證據與待決事項。核心 trade-off 是 coverage 與 risk：門檻太嚴會降低自動化率，太鬆則讓錯誤通過。評估時應同時看 handled cases 的 accuracy、overall coverage 與高風險錯誤率。知道何時不回答，本身就是可靠 AI 的能力。
paragraphs.ja: AI systemにすべてのinputへの回答を強制すると、高risk場面では危険です。abstain optionを設ければ、confidence不足、missing field、retrieval失敗、異常inputなどで自動処理を止めhuman reviewへ渡せます。confidence scoreだけではcalibration問題があるため複数signalを組み合わせます。human fallbackにも、なぜabstainしたか、どのevidenceがあるか、何を判断するかを表示する設計が必要です。thresholdを厳しくするとcoverageが下がり、緩くするとriskが増えます。評価ではaccuracyだけでなくcoverageとhigh-risk errorも見るべきです。

vocabulary.usage: The system can abstain when uncertain.

quiz.question: Why is confidence alone insufficient?
quiz.answer: It can be poorly calibrated, especially on unfamiliar inputs.
